Studi Kasus 1 — Kesalahan Pencatatan Lab: Case Study 1 — Past Profit Recording Error
Pada laporan pembukuan PT Alpha tahun 20:
In the bookkeeping report of PT Alpha for the year 2026, there is an addition of "Retained Earnings Beginning Balance" of Rp 800,000,000.
• This addition arises because the accounting department just realized an error in calculating the depreciation expense of assets (such as machinery/buildings) in the previous two years (2024 and 2025).
• As a result of this profit-increasing adjustment, the company must also calculate its tax deduction effect of Rp 176,000,000.
Karena perbaikan (koreksi) dari masa lal: Since this correction from the past results in an increase in the current retained earnings balance, what kind of calculation error did the accounting team actually make in the asset cost reports for the years 2024 and 2025?
Mengapa angka perbaikan Rp800.000.000 in: Why should this correction amount of Rp 800,000,000 not be recorded simply as "Other Income" in the 2026 income statement, but must instead be directly adjusted to Retained Earnings?
Saat Anda menyusun laporan kekayaan peru: When you prepare the company's balance sheet at the end of 2026, you are also required to display a comparison table with the 2025 figures. What adjustments must you make to the asset value and tax liability records in the 2025 column to make the report consistent?
Studi Kasus 2 — Transaksi Internal Induk: Case Study 2 — Intercompany Transactions between Parent and Subsidiary
Pada akhir tahun, saat menyusun laporan:
At the end of the year, when preparing consolidated financial statements between a Parent and its Subsidiary, the accountant must "eliminate" the records of buying and selling transactions between themselves.
• The elimination journal entries made are: Eliminating Sales Revenue Rp 1,000,000,000 (Debit), reducing Cost of Goods Sold/COGS Rp 800,000,000 (Credit), and writing down the Inventory value by Rp 200,000,000 (Credit).
Berapa modal awal dan harga jual antar-p: What are the initial cost and the selling price between the companies? And why must the inventory value be reduced by Rp 200,000,000 at the end of the year?
Jika Anak Perusahaan yang menjual ke Ind: If the Subsidiary sold to the Parent, why does this Rp 200,000,000 write-down cause the profit share of minority shareholders to also decrease?
Jika sisa barang tersebut akhirnya laku: If the remaining goods are finally sold to an external party next year, how should this deferred profit be recognized in next year's report?

Mengapa kenaikan nilai bangunan ini mema: Why does this increase in building value force the company to record a future tax liability (Rp 2.2 Billion), even though the building has not been sold and there is no actual bill from the tax office?
Apa dampak langsung dari munculnya utang: What is the direct impact of the emergence of this deferred tax liability and Rp 7.8 Billion surplus on the company's debt-to-equity ratio (DER) and return on equity (ROE)?
Pada tahun-tahun berikutnya saat banguna: In subsequent years when this building begins to be depreciated at the new higher value, how do you amortize or reverse the Deferred Tax Liability account in the bookkeeping?

Keuntungan Rp800 juta masuk ke laporan l: The Rp 800 million gain goes to the income statement. How do you record this non-cash gain in the Statement of Cash Flows (Indirect Method) to prevent miscalculation of cash?
Untuk menghitung sisa Utang Sewa yang ba: To calculate the new remaining Lease Liability, which discount rate should the company use: the original rate at inception, or the updated rate at the modification date? Give your reason.

Mengapa jurnal pemindahan ini sama sekal: Why does this reclassification journal not change the total Equity in the year-end Balance Sheet at all, even though the company just added a Rp 3 Billion gain to the Income Statement?
Akun OCI sering disebut \"tempat parkir\: The OCI account is often called a "parking lot" for unrealized gains. What loophole or trick can management exploit from this "parking lot" to manipulate shareholder perception so that annual Net Income always looks good?
Studi Kasus 1 — Selisih Dokumen (Tagihan: Case Study 1 — Document Discrepancy (Invoice vs Received Goods)
Sebuah vendor mengirimkan tagihan (Invoi:
A vendor sends an invoice for 100 laptop units.
• However, when you check the delivery note/goods receipt from the warehouse, it turns out the warehouse only received 90 laptop units (10 units were defective and returned).
• The vendor insists on full payment for 100 units as per the invoice they issued.
Mengapa staf AP dilarang keras memproses: Why are AP staff strictly prohibited from processing payments solely by looking at a vendor's invoice without checking the warehouse receipt document?
Apa tindakan yang harus Anda lakukan unt: What actions should you take to reconcile the data discrepancy between the vendor and your company's warehouse?
Tuliskan 1 kalimat balasan taktis kepada: Write one tactical reply sentence to the vendor explaining that you will only transfer payment for 90 units, without causing offense.
Studi Kasus 2 — Ancaman Vendor & Krisis: Case Study 2 — Vendor Threats & Cash Flow Crisis
Vendor bahan baku marah besar karena tag:
A raw material vendor is furious because their bill is 2 weeks overdue. They threaten to stop delivering goods tomorrow morning.
• Your Finance Manager instructs you to hold all payments because the company's cash is depleted and new funds will only arrive next week.
Jika Anda takut dimarahi lalu mengabaika: If you are afraid of being scolded and choose to ignore the vendor's calls (ghosting), what is the worst impact on your company's factory operations tomorrow morning?
Anda terjepit antara instruksi bos (kas: You are caught between your boss's instructions (depleted cash) and the vendor's threat. How do you behave professionally on the phone when facing the vendor's anger?
Tuliskan 1 kalimat negosiasi untuk menen: Write one negotiation sentence to calm the vendor and reassure them that the payment will definitely be made next week so that tomorrow's delivery is not suspended.
Studi Kasus 3 — Bahaya Tagihan Ganda (Do: Case Study 3 — The Danger of Double Payment
Anda menerima Invoice tagihan service AC:
You receive an AC service invoice worth Rp 10,000,000. When about to enter it into the system, it feels familiar and you find that an invoice with the exact same PO (Purchase Order) number and amount was already paid last month.
• The vendor claims it was just a "system print error on their side" and urges you to pay it anyway.
Apa kerugian fatal bagi perusahaan dan k: What is the fatal consequence for the company and your career if you carelessly execute a double payment for the same job?
Sebutkan 2 bukti dokumen/data yang wajib: Name 2 pieces of documentary evidence/data that you must screenshot or present to the vendor to prove that the invoice was indeed settled last month.
Buat 1 SOP (Aturan Pengecekan) sederhana: Create one simple SOP (Checking Rule) at the AP desk so that double payment slips never occur.
Seorang konsultan freelance mengirimkan:
A freelance consultant sends a service invoice of Rp 10,000,000.
• As an AP, regulations require you to deduct Income Tax (PPh 21), so the amount transferred to their account is less than 10 million.
• The consultant strongly protests: "I don't care about tax, I just want exactly 10 million in my account!"
Mengapa perusahaan (melalui staf AP) waj: Why is the company (through the AP staff) required to deduct the tax directly, rather than letting the consultant handle their own tax?
Tuliskan 1 kalimat penjelasan sederhana: Write one simple explanation (in layman's terms) to the consultant so they understand that the deduction is a mandatory state regulation, not because the company is stingy!
Jika atasan dari divisi lain menyuruh An: If a supervisor from another division tells you: "Just pay the full 10 million, let's just hide the tax so they don't get angry." What is your firm response as an AP staff member?
Studi Kasus 5 — Pembayaran Darurat Tanpa: Case Study 5 — Emergency Payment Without Signature
Direktur sedang di luar negeri dan tidak:
The Director is abroad and unreachable. Suddenly, the Marketing Manager approaches the AP desk and urges you to immediately transfer a DP (Down Payment) for building rent of Rp 50,000,000 for tomorrow morning's event.
• There is no official document (PO) or the Director's signing approval yet.
• The manager says: "Just transfer it now, if there's any problem, I will take full responsibility!"
Secara audit keuangan, mengapa alasan \": In terms of financial audit, why does the Marketing Manager's promise of "taking responsibility" offer you absolutely no protection if issues arise later?
Apa resiko terburuk jika AP membiasakan: What is the worst risk if an AP makes it a habit to transfer tens of millions based solely on verbal requests or instructions without written documentation?
Anda dilarang mentransfer tanpa persetuj: You are forbidden to transfer without approval, but tomorrow's event must go on. Propose one alternative solution so that the Marketing Manager can still legally pay the building deposit today.
Studi Kasus 1 — Menghadapi Klien Ghostin: Case Study 1 — Facing a Ghosting Client (Evading Bills)
Sebuah klien besar belum membayar tagiha:
A major client has not paid an invoice that is 30 days past due.
• When you call, they don't answer, and they don't reply to emails (ghosting).
• The Sales team at the office tells you: "Just wait, don't follow up too hard, they are an important client; they might get angry and leave for a competitor."
Mengapa menuruti kata-kata tim Sales unt: Why does following the Sales team's advice to "just wait and do nothing" severely endanger our company's cash flow?
Karena klien ini suka ghosting, apa 1 ti: Since this client likes to ghost, what is one firm yet professional action you will take other than continuously calling/WhatsApping?
Tuliskan 1 draf pesan singkat ke klien t: Write one short draft message to the client demanding payment, without sounding like a debt collector's threat.
Studi Kasus 2 — Konflik Batas Kredit (AR: Case Study 2 — Credit Limit Conflict (AR vs Sales Team)
Seorang klien sudah mencapai batas maksi:
A client has reached their maximum Credit Limit and is still outstanding on last month's payment.
• Suddenly, the Sales Manager forces you to unblock the system today so that the client's new order can be shipped.
• The Sales Manager promises: "Just unblock the system, I guarantee their old invoice will be transferred tomorrow!"
Secara audit keuangan, mengapa jaminan l: In terms of financial audit, why must the Sales Manager's verbal guarantee of "definitely paid tomorrow" never be used as a basis to unblock the system?
Jika Anda nekat menuruti Manajer Sales l: If you recklessly follow the Sales Manager's request and the client subsequently defaults or goes bankrupt, who will be held most responsible by the auditor/company: you (AR) or the Sales Manager? Explain your reasoning.
Tuliskan 1 kalimat balasan tegas kepada: Write one firm response sentence to the Sales Manager rejecting the request, but provide one conditional solution if the goods absolutely must be shipped today.
Studi Kasus 3 — Potongan Pembayaran Sepi: Case Study 3 — Unilateral Payment Deduction (Partial Payment)
Klien mentransfer uang tagihan, tapi jum:
A client transfers the invoice payment, but the amount is 20% short of the total invoice.
• When confirmed, the client claims: "There were some slightly defective goods, so I deducted 20% myself as compensation."
• However, the client has never reported the defective goods to your office prior to this.
Mengapa tindakan klien memotong pembayar: Why does the client's action of unilaterally deducting the payment severely violate accounts receivable (AR) administration rules?
Siapa departemen internal yang wajib And: Which internal department must you contact first to validate the truth of the client's claim regarding the defective goods?
Tuliskan 1 kalimat penjelasan kepada kli: Write one explanation sentence to the client stating that they must still settle the remaining 20% today, and explain the correct procedure if there is indeed a return/defective goods.
Studi Kasus 4 — Misteri Transfer Tanpa N: Case Study 4 — The Mystery of Unidentified Transfer
Ada uang masuk ke rekening perusahaan se:
There is incoming funds to the company's account amounting to Rp 25,000,000.
• However, in the bank statement there is no sender name, no transfer reference, and no invoice number.
• At the same time, there are 3 different clients whose outstanding debt is close to that figure.
Apa bahayanya jika Anda asal menebak dan: What is the danger if you make a guess and immediately apply the payment to reduce the debt of client A (the client with the oldest overdue balance)?
Daripada bertanya ke semua klien satu pe: Instead of asking all clients one by one, list 2 ways/supporting data you can examine to verify the actual sender of the funds!
Buat 1 SOP (Aturan Pengecekan) sederhana: Create one simple SOP (Checking Rule) that the Sales team must convey to all clients so that the "unidentified transfer" problem does not recur.
Studi Kasus 5 — Bukti Transfer Palsu (Mo: Case Study 5 — Fake Transfer Proof (Quick Fraud Scheme)
Seorang klien baru mengirimkan foto/scre:
A new client sends a photo/screenshot of m-Banking transfer proof via WhatsApp in the late afternoon.
• They urge you to immediately issue a Delivery Order (DO) so that the goods can be picked up by the courier that very second.
• However, when you check the company's Internet Banking transactions, the funds have not cleared at all.
• The client argues: "It's a different bank, it's normal for it to take time. Just send the goods first, after all I've sent the proof of transfer!"
Sebagai AR, mengapa screenshot bukti tra: As an AR, why will a client's screenshot of transfer proof never be considered valid proof of payment?
Menghadapi desakan klien yang marah-mara: Facing the pressure of an angry client demanding immediate shipment, what is your absolute decision that afternoon: Ship the goods OR Hold the goods?
Tuliskan 1 kalimat balasan standar kepad: Write one standard reply sentence to the client explaining the company's release policy, without directly accusing them of sending fake proof.
Studi Kasus 1 — Pemalsuan Tagihan demi T: Case Study 1 — Invoice Falsification for Year-End Targets
Menjelang tutup buku akhir tahun (29 Des:
Close to the year-end closing (December 29), the Sales Manager forces you to issue an invoice and tax invoice worth Rp 450,000,000 to Customer A so that the sales division's annual sales target is met.
• Physically, however, the goods are not ready and will only be shipped by the warehouse with a Delivery Order (DO) on January 3 of the following year.
Jika tagihan itu tetap dicatat sebagai p: If the invoice is still recorded as a sale in December even though the goods have not been shipped, what is the negative impact on the accuracy of the company's financial statements and tax reporting at year-end?
Pelanggan akhirnya menolak membayar kare: The customer ultimately refuses to pay because they have not received the goods. If the auditor discovers this target manipulation practice, what is the company's biggest loss?
Karena data tagihan bulan Desember sudah: Since the December billing data is already "locked" in the computer system and cannot simply be deleted, what official corrective document must you issue to cancel the invoice?
Studi Kasus 2 — Pengiriman Barang Sebagi: Case Study 2 — Partial Shipment and Billing Errors
Pelanggan menerbitkan Purchase Order (PO:
A customer issues a Purchase Order (PO) for 1,000 units of goods. In the system, you create a Sales Order (SO) for 1,000 units. Due to short stock, the warehouse only ships 920 units (Delivery Order / DO).
• However, when processing the billing, you pull data directly from the SO and issue an invoice for 1,000 units. The customer gets angry and holds all payments.
Mengapa mencetak tagihan berdasarkan jum: Why is printing an invoice based on the initial order quantity (rather than the quantity of goods actually shipped) a fatal error? Which documents should be matched before an invoice is printed?
Karena pelanggan menahan seluruh pembaya: Because the customer holds all payments due to this document error, what negative impact/financial loss will be immediately felt by the company?
Jika pelanggan sebelumnya mendapat harga: If the customer previously received a discount for purchasing 1,000 units, what corrective document must you prepare now so they pay for the 920 units, without losing their discount right for the remaining 80 units later?
Studi Kasus 3 — Barang Retur dan Masalah: Case Study 3 — Returned Goods and Credit Limit Issues
Pelanggan mengembalikan barang cacat sen:
A customer returns defective goods worth Rp 75,000,000.
• The goods were received by the warehouse at the end of the month, but you delay recording the return document in the system until next month.
• As a result, when the customer wants to order new goods at the beginning of the month, the system automatically rejects the order because the customer is deemed to have "exceeded their Credit Limit" (having not paid the Rp 75,000,000).
Mengapa menunda mencatat dokumen barang: Why can delaying the recording of returned goods documents in the computer system lead to fatal consequences and directly hurt the company's sales target in the following month?
Menurut alur kerja yang benar, sebutkan: According to the correct workflow, list 3 process sequences that should be immediately completed as soon as physical goods from the customer arrive back at our warehouse door.
Karena pelanggan sudah marah pesanannya: Since the customer is already angry that their order was rejected and your return document takes time to process, what emergency action can you communicate to your supervisor (Finance Manager) so the customer's new order can still be processed today?
Studi Kasus 4 — Tagihan Macet Karena Kes: Case Study 4 — Overdue Bills Due to Administrative Errors
Sebuah Invoice senilai Rp 620.000.000 su:
An invoice worth Rp 620,000,000 is 45 days past due.
• When followed up by the Finance department, the customer refuses to pay, stating: "We have never received the physical bill, and the Purchase Order (PO) number written on the bill is incorrect."
• It turns out the Sales Admin made a typo on the number because they only accepted the order via WhatsApp without checking the official email.
• To make matters worse, the proof of delivery (the delivery note signed by the customer) was lost by the courier.
Mengapa kehilangan surat tanda terima ba: Why does losing the proof of delivery note and typing the wrong order number put the customer in an extremely strong position to refuse payment? What happens if the company recklessly sues the customer in court?
Sebagai Admin Penjualan, sebutkan dokume: As a Sales Admin, what supporting documents must be attached alongside the main bill (Invoice) to prevent the customer from finding excuses to reject the bill?
Meskipun tugas menagih uang ada di bagia: Although the task of collecting payments lies with Finance, what simple preventive action should a Sales Admin take a few days after the goods are shipped to ensure the excuse "bill has not arrived" never happens?
Studi Kasus 5 — Selisih Data Penjualan d: Case Study 5 — Discrepancy between Sales and Warehouse Data
Pada laporan akhir bulan, catatan di sis:
On the month-end report, records in the Sales system show 2,000 units sold and billed.
• However, records in the Warehouse system show only 1,850 units actually left the warehouse. There is a mysterious discrepancy of 150 units between sales data and physical warehouse data.
Selain kemungkinan barangnya hilang seca: Aside from physical loss of goods, how can a Marketing promo program (e.g. "Buy 10 Get 1 Free") cause this discrepancy if the Sales Admin enters the wrong promo code in the system?
Jika ternyata 150 unit tersebut adalah b: If the 150 units are consignment goods to another store, why is issuing a full sales invoice now a big mistake for the company's finance? When should consignment goods be officially recognized as sales?
Langkah pemeriksaan dokumen (pencocokan: What document verification steps (data matching) will you carry out with the warehouse team to prove definitively where the 150-unit discrepancy error lies?
